member.name: T:PolyPrompt.Clients.AnthropicClient
member.summary: Client for the Anthropic (Claude) Messages API supporting chat completions, tool calling, and text generation. Anthropic has no embeddings API and no legacy completions endpoint; embeddings throw and text generation is mapped onto the Messages API as a single-user-turn request.

member.summary: Workspace identifier sent in the anthropic-workspace-id request header. Default: null (no header is sent). Identity-linked Anthropic API keys reject requests without it; standard workspace API keys do not require it. Set to null to remove the header.

member.name: P:PolyPrompt.Clients.AnthropicClient.ModelsPageLimit
